## Findings
<a id="findings"></a>

- <a id="research.backend-src-calendar-dto.acc9046f"></a>**1. The unit backend/src/calendar/dto contains five source files — add-events.dto.ts, calendar-list.dto.ts, event-config.dto.ts, generate-ics.dto.ts, and index.ts — which together define the calendar module's data-transfer objects.**

  [`generate-ics.dto.ts:1-56`](../generate-ics.dto.ts#L1-L56)
  [`index.ts:1-4`](../index.ts#L1-L4)
- <a id="research.backend-src-calendar-dto.d65e12ed"></a>**2. The unit's DTOs are consumed by the calendar module's controller and services: calendar.controller.ts imports CalendarListDto, CalendarDto, CreateCalendarDto, AddEventsDto, and GenerateIcsDto; calendar.service.ts imports CalendarDto and EventConfigDto; and ics.service.ts imports EventConfigDto.**
  [`calendar.controller.ts:22-28`](../../calendar.controller.ts#L22-L28)
  [`calendar.service.ts:4-5`](../../calendar.service.ts#L4-L5)
  [`ics.service.ts:2-2`](../../ics.service.ts#L2-L2)
- <a id="research.backend-src-calendar-dto.ba516a14"></a>**3. AddEventsDto, exported from add-events.dto.ts, is the request body for adding events to a Google Calendar: it requires a calendarId string and an events array of EventConfigDto, and optionally accepts semesterStart and semesterEnd ISO date strings and a pdfType from the PdfType enum.**
  [`add-events.dto.ts:7-63`](../add-events.dto.ts#L7-L63)
- <a id="research.backend-src-calendar-dto.06060975"></a>**4. CalendarDto, exported from calendar-list.dto.ts, describes a Google Calendar with required id and summary string fields and optional description string, primary boolean, and backgroundColor string fields.**
  [`calendar-list.dto.ts:5-28`](../calendar-list.dto.ts#L5-L28)
- <a id="research.backend-src-calendar-dto.2ad7a509"></a>**5. CalendarListDto, exported from calendar-list.dto.ts, wraps a list of calendars in a single required calendars field typed as CalendarDto[] and validated with @IsArray, @ValidateNested({ each: true }), and @Type(() => CalendarDto).**
  [`calendar-list.dto.ts:30-36`](../calendar-list.dto.ts#L30-L36)
- <a id="research.backend-src-calendar-dto.40e94606"></a>**6. CreateCalendarDto, exported from calendar-list.dto.ts, is the request body for creating a new calendar: it requires a name string and optionally accepts a description string.**
  [`calendar-list.dto.ts:38-47`](../calendar-list.dto.ts#L38-L47)
- <a id="research.backend-src-calendar-dto.9500b6e7"></a>**7. EventConfigDto, exported from event-config.dto.ts, describes a single calendar event with required id (UUID), summary, location, startTime, endTime, isRecurring (boolean), and colorId fields, and optional day, date, notes, and semester string fields.**
  [`event-config.dto.ts:10-111`](../event-config.dto.ts#L10-L111)
- <a id="research.backend-src-calendar-dto.7e196b5d"></a>**8. GenerateIcsDto, exported from generate-ics.dto.ts, is the request body for generating an ICS file: it requires an events array of EventConfigDto and optionally accepts semesterStart and semesterEnd ISO date strings and a pdfType from the PdfType enum.**
  [`generate-ics.dto.ts:7-56`](../generate-ics.dto.ts#L7-L56)
- <a id="research.backend-src-calendar-dto.4410e692"></a>**9. index.ts re-exports all four DTO modules — event-config.dto.js, add-events.dto.js, calendar-list.dto.js, and generate-ics.dto.js — so the unit's DTOs are importable from a single entry point.**
  [`index.ts:1-4`](../index.ts#L1-L4)
- <a id="research.backend-src-calendar-dto.a1c3c634"></a>**10. All DTO classes in the unit use decorators from @nestjs/swagger (@ApiProperty, @ApiPropertyOptional), class-validator (@IsString, @IsArray, @IsBoolean, @IsDateString, @IsEnum, @IsOptional, @IsUUID, @Matches, @ValidateNested), and class-transformer (@Type) to document, validate, and transform request and response payloads.**
  [`add-events.dto.ts:1-3`](../add-events.dto.ts#L1-L3)
  [`calendar-list.dto.ts:1-3`](../calendar-list.dto.ts#L1-L3)
  [`event-config.dto.ts:1-8`](../event-config.dto.ts#L1-L8)
  [`generate-ics.dto.ts:1-3`](../generate-ics.dto.ts#L1-L3)
- <a id="research.backend-src-calendar-dto.36976215"></a>**11. add-events.dto.ts and generate-ics.dto.ts both import PdfType from ../../common/types.js, where PdfType is an enum with LECTURE, TEST, and EXAM members, and use it to type their optional pdfType field.**
  [`add-events.dto.ts:5-5`](../add-events.dto.ts#L5-L5)
  [`add-events.dto.ts:51-63`](../add-events.dto.ts#L51-L63)
  [`generate-ics.dto.ts:5-5`](../generate-ics.dto.ts#L5-L5)
  [`generate-ics.dto.ts:43-55`](../generate-ics.dto.ts#L43-L55)
  [`types.ts:1-5`](../../../common/types.ts#L1-L5)
- <a id="research.backend-src-calendar-dto.9fc660bd"></a>**12. EventConfigDto validates its id with @IsUUID and its startTime and endTime with @Matches(/^\d{2}:\d{2}$/) to enforce the HH:MM 24-hour format, with custom validation messages for the time fields.**
  [`event-config.dto.ts:11-16`](../event-config.dto.ts#L11-L16)
  [`event-config.dto.ts:36-54`](../event-config.dto.ts#L36-L54)
- <a id="research.backend-src-calendar-dto.e0536527"></a>**13. AddEventsDto's fields are validated with class-validator decorators — @IsString on calendarId, @IsArray with @ValidateNested({ each: true }) and @Type(() => EventConfigDto) on events, @IsOptional @IsDateString on semesterStart and semesterEnd, and @IsOptional @IsEnum(PdfType) on pdfType — and every field is documented with @ApiProperty or @ApiPropertyOptional from @nestjs/swagger.**
  [`add-events.dto.ts:1-5`](../add-events.dto.ts#L1-L5)
